Which of your products is best for that, and why is it a good fit?
If you are looking for protein supplements, two of our standout options that showcase our commitment to quality are:
1. Whey Protein Isolate Powder: This is our flagship WPI90 protein. It undergoes a cold cross-flow microfiltration process that preserves the protein structure while removing virtually all fat, sugar, and lactose (less than 1g per serving). It delivers 25g of pure protein per scoop without any amino spiking. It's an ideal choice if you want maximum purity or have a sensitive stomach.
2. Signature Protein: This formula combines three high-quality protein sources (milk protein isolate, micellar casein, and egg white protein). Because each protein digests at a different rate, it provides both immediate and sustained protein delivery throughout the day. It also includes a digestive enzyme complex to help prevent bloating.
Both products come with 100% full label disclosure and independent 3rd-party lab testing for every batch.
